ClientResponses.Response:
Your feedback means a lot to us. We are very sorry to hear you are not completely satisfied with your new grill. We will be sure to share your concerns with our team. 

With regards to food sticking, we have the following recommendations:
 
You can oil the food directly, but we do not recommend applying any kind of oil directly to the grates. 
 
Make sure you're giving your food enough time per side. Food will naturally start to release from the grates when close to flipping time.
 
If using a marinade, try to get as much excess liquid off as possible before placing the food on the grill.
 
If using a sauce of any kind, wait until the last 5 minutes or so to apply.
 
We recommend cleaning your cooking grates every time you use your grill. Simply preheat the grill on high for 15 minutes with the lid closed and then brush the grates clean with a Weber Stainless Steel Grill Brush.

Our Care team will be reaching out to assist you further. Please look for an email outreach from us soon. Thank you!
